// Flat tensile test specimen (dog bone)
// Lies flat on the bed, symmetric about the origin in X and Y.

// ---- Dimensions (mm) ----
thickness     = 4;    // specimen thickness (Z)
gauge_w       = 10;   // gauge section width (Y)
gauge_l       = 50;   // gauge section length (X)
grip_w        = 15;   // grip section width (Y)
grip_l        = 30;   // grip section length (X), each end
trans_l       = 15;   // transition length (X), each side, linear taper
total_l       = gauge_l + 2*trans_l + 2*grip_l;  // = 140 mm overall

// ---- Derived X stations ----
x_g = gauge_l/2;              // end of gauge section (25)
x_t = x_g + trans_l;          // end of transition (40)
x_e = total_l/2;              // end of grip (70)

// ---- Outline (top view), counter-clockwise ----
outline = [
    [-x_e, -grip_w/2],
    [-x_t, -grip_w/2],
    [-x_g, -gauge_w/2],
    [ x_g, -gauge_w/2],
    [ x_t, -grip_w/2],
    [ x_e, -grip_w/2],
    [ x_e,  grip_w/2],
    [ x_t,  grip_w/2],
    [ x_g,  gauge_w/2],
    [-x_g,  gauge_w/2],
    [-x_t,  grip_w/2],
    [-x_e,  grip_w/2]
];

// ---- Part ----
linear_extrude(height = thickness)
    polygon(points = outline);
